status: draft: gameplay terminology and presentation require review

reroll.description_en: Reroll one set of three choices.

freeze.description_en: Freezes the boss for 4 seconds after combat begins.

slow.description_en: Slows the boss by 40% for the first 10 seconds of combat.

sunder.description_en: The boss takes 30% more damage on this floor.

shachi.description_en: Increases Sha-Chi recovery by 40% on this floor.

intel.description_en: Reveals information about one side in a spectator battle (not yet active).

borrow.description_en: Adds one ally to the next team battle (not yet active).

revive.description_en: Automatically revives you once with full HP, full Sha-Chi, and refilled medicine.

guard.description_en: Reduces damage taken by 20% on this floor.

edge.description_en: Increases attack and guard-breaking power by 15% on this floor.

break.description_en: Increases Sha-Chi damage dealt to the boss by 30% on this floor.

rebirth.description_en: If you fall without a Revival Talisman, continue 10 floors earlier instead of restarting. If you fall within the first 10 floors, continue from floor 1.

kuanxin.description_en: Doubles the parry window on this floor.

baidu.description_en: Grants immunity to status effects on this floor.

yingwu.description_en: Grants unlimited Phantom Edges on this floor.

jifeng.description_en: Increases attack speed by 25% on this floor.

ponian.description_en: Breaks enemy guard in one hit on this floor.

huajin.description_en: Automatically blocks normal attacks on this floor.

youshen.description_en: Automatically dodges normal attacks on this floor.

lingxi_blue.description_en: Automatically blocks blue-flash attacks on this floor.

lingxi_red.description_en: Automatically dodges red-flash attacks on this floor.

spring.description_en: Restore 15% HP at the start of each floor (retired; no longer offered).

riposte.description_en: Attack +15% for 3 seconds after a perfect block.
